summary: WV State Parks' Kumbrabow camping page confirms the inherited booking rules for this campground (reserve online/phone/office at book.wvstateparks.com, 2-night Fri+Sat weekend minimum, 14-night max) and gives sites: 13 primitive + 1 large RV pull-through site up to 60 ft (14 sites). Season: spring through fall, weather permitting, no dates. Fees ($21.99 non-electric, booking site 2026-10-12) left. Not stated: hookups, toilets/water. Note (AWH) unchanged.
flags: Name: WV State Parks calls it 'Mill Creek Campground' ('Kumbrabow State Forests Mill Creek Campground offers 13 primitive sites and one large RV site'); the entry is 'Kumbrabow Crossing'. Suggest 'Mill Creek Campground (Kumbrabow State Forest)'.
Missing phone: Kumbrabow State Forest 304-335-2219 (park page).

Criteria (soft): only ONE site is described as an RV site ('one large RV site', 'Up to 60′ RV, pull-through site'); the other 13 are 'primitive' with no length given, so a 23-ft motorhome may depend on that one site.
